elements.requirement: A sales contract must be treated as including the provisions set out in section 29 as terms.
elements.quote: A sales contract is to be treated as including the following provisions as terms.

elements.requirement: The goods under a sales contract remain at the trader's risk until they come into the physical possession of the consumer or a person identified by the consumer to take possession of the goods.
elements.quote: The goods remain at the trader's risk until they come into the physical possession of— (a) the consumer, or (b) a person identified by the consumer to take possession of the goods.

elements.requirement: The rule keeping goods at the trader's risk until physical possession does not apply if the goods are delivered to a carrier who is commissioned by the consumer to deliver the goods and is not a carrier the trader named as an option for the consumer.
elements.quote: Subsection (2) does not apply if the goods are delivered to a carrier who— (a) is commissioned by the consumer to deliver the goods, and (b) is not a carrier the trader named as an option for the consumer.

elements.requirement: The goods are at the consumer's risk on and after delivery to a carrier if that carrier was commissioned by the consumer and was not named by the trader as an option.
elements.quote: In that case the goods are at the consumer's risk on and after delivery to the carrier.

elements.requirement: The placement of risk on the consumer upon delivery to the carrier does not affect any liability of that carrier to the consumer in respect of the goods.
elements.quote: Subsection (4) does not affect any liability of the carrier to the consumer in respect of the goods.

elements.requirement: The application of section 29 where goods are sold at public auction is governed by section 2(5) and (6).
elements.quote: See section 2(5) and (6) for the application of this section where goods are sold at public auction.
